kind: gas solubility: liquid mole fraction of hydrogen at T and P

source.citation: R. Aslam, K. Mueller, M. Mueller, M. Koch, P. Wasserscheid, W. Arlt, Measurement of Hydrogen Solubility in Potential Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carriers, J. Chem. Eng. Data 61 (2016) 643-649
source.access: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive, free access to the data of J. Chem. Eng. Data
source.tables: ThermoML file: 4th PureOrMixtureData block (toluene + hydrogen; mole fraction of hydrogen in the liquid as a function of temperature, K, and pressure, kPa). Expanded uncertainty of x_H2 from nCombExpandUncertValue.
source.transcription: Read from the ThermoML XML with a web-reading tool; two independent readings agreed on every value. The reviewer should compare each row with the XML.

notes: x_H2 is the mole fraction of hydrogen in the liquid at the stated T and P (total pressure). The expanded uncertainty of x_H2 is about 10 %.
